remarks: Not to be missed! 86 Old Norwalk Road, New Canaan, a charming gambrel colonial set on an oversized corner lot of cul de sac street.  Enjoy both natural beauty and convenient access to schools, parks, and downtown New Canaan.  Located on a sidewalk-lined street, enjoy a scenic stroll to New Canaan's top-rated schools or take the nearby hiking trails to Kiwanis Park, featuring a playground. The peaceful property boasts beautiful English-style gardens with stonework, including a hummingbird & pollinator garden for viewing from the screened porch. The original carriage house with loft provides additional space for your wildest dreams.  Enjoy outdoor living & entertaining with a newly finished over 1000 Sq Ft deck off the kitchen. Inside, the home offers three spacious bedrooms, two and a half bathrooms, and a finished basement with a family room and office. This bright home has oversized windows in living and dining room with nature views from every room. With a freshly painted interior and exterior, generator hook-up with an included gas generator, and thoughtful updates throughout, this home is ready for you to move in with fewer worries and more time to enjoy everything New Canaan has to offer.
